headline: Confirmed 4H reversal off the $60.03 capitulation low

meta.market_state_note: Capitulation low → confirmed 4H bullish reversal, but the daily is still bearish. Two-sided by timeframe: don't chase $67.8 — long a pullback to $65-66, or wait for the rally into $76-82 to short with the dominant bearish bias.

factors.evidence: Downtrend from the ~$98 top (-65% over the window from $253). A waterfall broke the $80-82 range floor and flushed to a fresh low $60.03; strong 2-day bounce since, but no daily higher high yet.
Price $67.8 below the 20 EMA (computed from daily closes).
Price below; 20 EMA ($75.9) below 50 EMA ($81.5) — bearish stack.
Price below AVWAP; sits overhead as resistance.
Recovered off the low to above the midline and above its MA — no longer bearish, not a bull regime.
Capitulation day carried 26M (vs ~12M avg); bounce days 9-13.5M — solid but below the flush.
Clear higher-highs/higher-lows sequence off $60.03 (60.03 → 61.3 → 63.5 → 65.4 → 66.5 lows; 63 → 65 → 67.9 → 68.2 highs). A genuine short-term uptrend, not a flat base.
Price $67.8 is above the 4H 20 EMA — reclaimed on the bounce.
Far below; stale far-back anchor (see Analyst Notes).
RSI back above the midline and well above its MA (40) — momentum has turned up.
Capitulation bars ran 4-6.6M; bounce bars 1.3-4.1M — rising but not strongly volume-confirmed.

setup.thesis: Tactical long the confirmed 4H reversal — ideally on a pullback to $65-66 (4H 20-EMA + prior breakout) rather than chasing $67.8 — targeting the daily means $75.9 → $79.2 (then $80-82). It's countertrend to a bearish daily, so treat it as a bounce-to-resistance with a defined cap; the higher-conviction swing trade is to short the rally as it reaches $76-82.
setup.not: Not Trend Continuation (the 4H has turned against the daily trend); not a Breakdown (acceptance below $60 never occurred).

verdict.rationale: Two-sided by timeframe, and not a chase at $67.8. The 4H is a confirmed bullish reversal — long a pullback to $65-66 (stop <$63, targets $75.9 then $79-82). But the daily is bearish, so the bounce likely caps at $76-82, where the higher-conviction short sets up. Long below, short into the supply — don't enter mid-move here.

evidence_matrix.reading: Confirmed HH/HL reversal off $60.03; reclaimed 4H 20 EMA
4H RSI ~55 > MA; daily RSI recovered to ~56
Building higher lows above the 4H 20 EMA (~$66)

analyst_summary: SOL is bearish on the swing but transitioning — the daily is below every mean (20/50 EMA stack + AVWAP) with LH/LL from ~$98, yet the 4H has flipped to a confirmed bullish reversal off the $60.03 capitulation low (HH/HL, 4H 20 EMA reclaimed, RSI back above its MA).
Two-sided by timeframe: the 4H favours a tactical long the bounce, the daily favours shorting the rally into supply. They're the same path — up into $76-82, then likely back down.
Don't chase $67.8: long a pullback to $65-66 (stop <$63, targets $75.9 then $79-82), or wait for the rally into $76-82 to short with the dominant bearish bias.

Caveats: bounce volume is moderate, not climactic-confirmed; OI/Funding/CVD unavailable; the 4H AVWAP (~$97) is a stale anchor (daily AVWAP $79.2 is the relevant resistance); SOL is high-beta to BTC — the path into $76-82 is largely a BTC call, so check BTC before acting.
bottom_line: Countertrend / reversal attempt — a tactical 4H bounce, not trend-following on the daily. Long a pullback to $65-66, or short the rally into $76-82; the same supply zone caps the bounce and sets up the higher-conviction short.

bullish_upgrade.title: Bullish Continuation
bullish_upgrade.subtitle: Bounce Extends
checks: 4H holds above the 20 EMA (~$66) on pullbacks
bullish_upgrade.result: Bounce extends toward $79-82; daily bias upgrades toward Neutral.

bearish_confirmation.title: Bearish Reassertion
bearish_confirmation.subtitle: Reversal Fails
bearish_confirmation.result: Daily bias reasserts; continuation toward $60 and lower.

bull_case: Capitulation at $60.03 then a confirmed 4H reversal (HH/HL, 4H 20 EMA reclaimed, RSI > MA) — a structured bounce targeting the daily means $75.9-79.2.
bear_case: Daily below every mean with LH/LL from $98; the bounce is a countertrend rally into heavy $72-82 supply that likely stalls and resumes lower toward $60.
failure_scenario: The bounce stalls into the $76-82 supply (daily 20 EMA + AVWAP + range floor), gets rejected, the bearish daily reasserts, and price rolls back toward $62-60 and retests the $60.03 low.
conclusion: Countertrend / Reversal Attempt — tactical 4H bounce, explicitly not trend-following on the daily.
